text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that teaches computers to see and understand the world through images and videos. Two core tasks are image recognition, which identifies what is in a picture (like a cat or a tree), and object detection, which locates specific objects within a scene and draws boxes around them. These technologies power many everyday applications, from facial recognition on your phone to medical scans that help doctors find diseases. Perhaps the most exciting use is in self-driving cars. By using cameras and advanced computer vision, these vehicles can detect pedestrians, traffic signs, and other cars in real time, making driving safer and more autonomous.
